obligationApplicability.heading: Does it apply to us?
obligationApplicability.separateFacts: Whether a rule applies and whether we comply are two separate facts, recorded separately.
obligationApplicability.reasonHint: A reasoned "does not apply" is worth as much to an auditor as an "applies".
obligationApplicability.confirmBody: It is stored at once in your name, with your reason, and kept in the audit log. It was "{before}". The compliance status and gaps stay as they are and return if it applies again.
obligationApplicability.stale: Someone changed this answer while you were deciding. Reload to see theirs, then decide again.
